outcome: cefazolin concentration in subcutaneous adipose tissue
cefazolin concentration in fetal cord blood
cohort: Women ≥18 years old with body mass index ≥30kg/m(2) who underwent scheduled cesarean delivery with singleton pregnancy
finding: Adequate cefazolin concentrations were achieved in blood for the majority of patients, however, concentration adequacy was not achieved in solid tissue for a nearly equally large proportion of patients.
